title: Android TabWidget: tab margins
purpose: Check that fixed-width Android XML tab indicators respect margins, including start and end margins in right-to-left layout.
changes: Fixed-width tabs now account for horizontal margins when laying out and shrinking to fit, and respect top and bottom margins. This example uses an XML layout with distinct margins.
steps: Turn on Tab margins example. The three tabs should have visible gaps; Second is slightly shorter vertically because it has top and bottom margins.
Select the tabs. Turn on Right-to-left layout and check that the tab order reverses and the start/end margins follow it.
Turn on Narrow widget. The tabs should shrink while their gaps remain. Try selecting the tabs again.
Choose OK if it works, or Reject with details and your device.
expected: Tabs retain their margin gaps and vertical spacing, the direction-aware margins follow RTL, and widths shrink when the widget is narrow.
limits: This covers fixed-width, unweighted children. Weighted and wrap-content measurement, Android pixel rounding and device appearance are not yet verified.
validation: Ten TabWidget Rust tests, seven TabHost tests and 155 XML importer tests passed.
A 320 × 650 browser test checked margin spacing, narrow layout and RTL.
